description: This file defines the ConnectivityConfig interface, which provides configuration settings for the Connectivity service in the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends multiple configuration interfaces and declares methods to access various sub-configurations such as connection, reconnect, client, monitoring, mapping, signal enrichment, and acknowledgment configurations.

classes.name: ConnectivityConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration methods for the Connectivity service, extending multiple other configuration interfaces.

methods.name: getReconnectConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for reconnect behavior.

methods.name: getClientConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for the service's client.

methods.name: getMonitoringConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for monitoring features such as connection logs and metrics.

methods.name: getMappingConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for message mapping.

methods.name: getSignalEnrichmentConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for signal enrichment.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for acknowledgment handling.
